items.title: OpenAI acquires Software Applications Incorporated, maker of Sky
items.summary: OpenAI has acquired Software Applications Incorporated, maker of Sky—a natural language interface for Mac that brings AI directly into your desktop experience. Together, we’re integrating Sky’s deep macOS capabilities into ChatGPT to make AI more intuitive, contextual, and action-oriented.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI宣布收购Software Applications Incorporated，该公司为Mac桌面自然语言界面应用Sky的开发商。OpenAI计划将Sky具备的深度macOS系统级交互能力整合至ChatGPT中，旨在打造更加直观、具备上下文感知能力且以行动为导向的桌面级AI体验，拓展生成式AI在操作系统层面的应用生态。

items.title: Consensus accelerates research with GPT-5 and Responses API
items.summary: Consensus uses GPT-5 and OpenAI’s Responses API to power a multi-agent research assistant that reads, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence in minutes—helping over 8 million researchers accelerate scientific discovery.
items.summaryZh: 科研检索平台Consensus宣布结合GPT-5模型与OpenAI的Responses API，打造出多智能体科研助手。该系统能在几分钟内阅读、分析并综合学术证据，目前已帮助超过800万名研究人员加速科学发现。该案例展示了最新旗舰大模型与专用API在复杂多智能体工作流及科研智能化中的实际落地应用。

aiReview.reasonZh: 学术平台Consensus基于GPT-5和Responses API构建多智能体科研助手，大幅提升文献分析效率。

items.title: AI in South Korea—OpenAI’s Economic Blueprint
items.summary: OpenAI's Korea Economic Blueprint outlines how South Korea can scale trusted AI through sovereign capabilities and strategic partnerships to drive growth.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布《韩国AI经济蓝图》，阐述如何通过建立主权AI能力及战略合作伙伴关系来扩展值得信赖的AI生态，以提升经济增长。该方案聚焦于国家级AI基础设施部署与政策协作。

items.title: Work smarter with your company knowledge in ChatGPT
items.summary: Company knowledge brings context from your apps into ChatGPT for answers specific to your business, with clear citations, security, privacy, and admin controls. Available now for Business, Enterprise, and Edu users.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI推出了针对商业、企业及教育版用户的“企业知识”（Company Knowledge）功能。该功能可将企业内部应用程序中的上下文数据无缝接入ChatGPT，在确保数据安全、隐私及管理员控制的前提下，提供带有明确来源引用的个性化业务解答，进一步深化了AI在企业工作流与知识管理中的实际应用价值。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI为ChatGPT企业级用户推出企业知识集成功能，支持跨应用场景的精准问答与引用。
